gloss: moving work; touching film or book

definitions.gloss: moving work; touching film or book
definitions.explanation: A film, novel, or other creative work that deeply moves its audience. Frequently used in advertising and reviews.

examples.japanese: ⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{感動作|かんどうさく}だ。
examples.english: This is the most moving work of the year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{涙|なみだ}→涙：02235_namida⟧なし⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{見|み}られない→見る：00283_miru⟧{感動作|かんどうさく}だった。
examples.english: It was a moving work you couldn't watch without tears.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{監督|かんとく}→監督：00185_kantoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦テーマ→テーマ：17684_teema⟧にした{感動作|かんどうさく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{知|し}られている→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: This director is known for moving works on the theme of family.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{感動|かんどう}→感動：00167_kandou⟧ (being moved, deep emotion) + ⟦{作|さく}→作：27430_saku⟧ (a work). Often used in promotional copy, as in ⟦{感動|かんどう}→感動：00167_kandou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{超大作|ちょうたいさく} (a moving blockbuster).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{話題|わだい}→話題：03793_wadai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{感動作|かんどうさく}: a talked-about moving work
- {感動作|かんどうさく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{生|う}み{出|だ}す→生み出す：10423_umidasu⟧: to create a moving work
